Author: Noffletoff
Name: Emote Commander
Description: Bind your own slash command to a Penumbra preset and a vanilla emote. Typing the command applies the mod options, redraws, and performs the emote - so your custom animation plays without opening Penumbra mid-scene. Other players see it through the sync service they already use.
Punchline: Bind your own slash commands to your animation mods.
